{{Quote|Allow me to test your knowledge of arcane historical esoterica. Have you ever heard of the Monarchomechs?|[[Tuden Sal]], to [[I-5YQ]]|<ref name="PoF" />}}
The '''Monarchomechs''' were an organization of [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] that existed about 400 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==History==
A group operating in the eastern [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Monarchomechs opposed their local [[Monarchy/Legends|Monarchy]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] many of their rulers. The group was made up of [[Cyborg/Legends|technology-encased organic]] [[Brain/Legends|brains]], similar to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr monks]]. The name "Monarchomech" is derived from the [[Middle Yutanese]] phrase for "killer of monarchs", reflecting their violent ways.<ref name="PoF" />
